description: MOS control 0xE1 value 0x0002: software switches the discharge MOSFET off and releases the charge MOSFET.
Vendor example: protection counters 0xAA, 24 data bytes (11 counters plus the system restart counter), all zero.
Parameter block read 0xFA: start parameter 0x0001, 2 parameters.
Parameter block reply: start 0x0001, count 2, words 0x0FA0 (cycle capacity 40.00 Ah) and 0x1036 (full voltage 4150 mV).
Parameter block read: start parameter 0x0038 (56, manufacturer), 16 parameters (32 bytes).
Manufacturer block: first byte 0x05 is the string length, "DGJBD"; the bytes after the length ("hjklzxc") are left over and must be ignored.
MOS control 0xFB (V1+ of the vendor protocol): YY = 0x01 charge MOSFET, XX = 0x01 software off. Not used by any open source implementation.
Acknowledgement of 0xFB: status 0, no data, checksum 0x0000.
Control command 0x0A, function code 0x0100: reset capacity (re-estimate the SOC from the voltage table).
Password pairing 0x06 for password 765828 per the V11 document: length byte 6, then the six digits as binary values 0..9 (not ASCII). bms-tools sends ASCII instead; both unverified (section 8.4).
Password change 0x07 from 765828 to 123456: length byte 12, old digits, new digits.
Read cell internal resistance 0xF6. The vendor marks the command as not implemented; no reply is documented reliably.

4 cell voltages of the same BMS.
Model string "JBD-SP04S034-L4S-200A-B-U" (25 ASCII bytes, no length prefix).
24 data bytes: cell overvoltage 122, cell undervoltage 2, last word (system restarts per vendor V11) 1.
Protection bit 12 (MOSFET software lock) set, only the discharge MOSFET on (FET status 0x02).
Overkill JBD-SP25S003-L16S-100A-100A-B on a bench supply: 23 data bytes, NTC count 0, total voltage and SOC 0, only the charge MOSFET on.
16 cell slots from a cell simulator: 15 x 3.600 V and cell 16 = 0 V (a zero cell is real data, not a parse error).
Same BMS read with jbdtool over a USB serial adapter at 9600 8N1.
Raw serial read: two stray bytes before a valid 0x04 frame. The assembler must skip bytes until 0xDD.

description: Hardware version of the newer module generation: "SP04S034L4S200A" (15 characters, no dashes), split 20 + 2 bytes.
Pack status request to address 1: function 0x78, start 0x1000, end 0x10A0, no data, CRC-16/MODBUS low byte first.
JBD-UP16S020 at address 1 (ECO-WORTHY 48 V 100 Ah rack battery): 53.17 V, 0.00 A, SOC 60.95 %, 16 cells, 4 temperatures, model "JBD48100000".
Second pack on the same bus: 53.21 V, SOC 73.00 %, 150 data bytes (shorter tail than address 1).
Pack parameter block request (start 0x1C00); answer layout only partly known, not decoded.
UP protocol MOSFET write (function 0x79, 0x2902..0x2904, marker 11 "JBD", value 0x0001 = discharge only). Constructed by the syssi unit test; no capture of the device answer.
